subject: Re: Migration & deployment-mode selection — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@aurora-health.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment mode & migration needs

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of what I heard
- Current setup: self-hosted Llama-based clusters on K8s (internal GPUs) for inference; your infra team spends ~2-3 FTEs on ops.
- Motivation: lower operational overhead, better latency for customer-facing features, and stricter controls for PHI-laden workflows.
- Primary evaluation choices: Redwood Hosted API (fast to market), Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools + private network options), Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem for strict compliance).

Key requirements you mentioned
- Throughput: ~5M tokens/day (spiky traffic during business hours).
- Latency SLO: 99th percentile target ~200ms for text-generation APIs.
- Security/compliance: need SOC 2 evidence and network isolation for PHI; at least one workload must stay in a customer-managed VPC.
- Timeline: pilot within 4–6 weeks; production migration in ~3 months if pilot goes well.
- Budget: looking for a predictable committed-cost option but flexible for initial pilot.

Open questions we agreed to surface
1) Which specific endpoints/workflows need PHI-only handling (private VPC) vs which can move to Dedicated/Hosted?
2) Network details for the private pilot (IP ranges, peering model, proxy requirements).
3) Current peak concurrency and average request size (tokens per request) so we can size Dedicated pool.

Proposed next steps
- I'll loop in Monica (Solutions) for a technical deep dive to validate latency sizing and network plan — can we book a 60-min session next week?
- I'll send a short SOW + pricing sheet for a Dedicated pilot with a private endpoint configuration and a fallback Hosted plan for non-PHI workloads (attached).
- If the answers to the open questions are ready before the call, please drop them into the Drive link I shared so Monica can pre-size the cluster.

Attachments: RDW_SOW_dedicated_vs_private.pdf, pricing-sheet-q1-2027.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
From: Samir Shah <samir@aurora-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@aurora-health.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment mode & migration needs

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications / answers below.

Answers to open questions
- PHI-sensitive workflows: patient intake form parsing and provider recommendation pipeline (approx 30% of requests) must remain inside customer-managed network with strict logging. The rest (autocomplete, internal analytics) can be on Dedicated or Hosted.
- Network: we prefer VPC peering (AWS) for the private workload. I'll share the IP ranges and peering contact in a separate email to Monica.
- Traffic: peak concurrency ~220 RPS during spikes; average request ~120 tokens, peaks up to 800 tokens for long responses.

Constraints / preferences
- We want to avoid a multi-month migration if possible. Ideal: pilot the Dedicated pool for 90% of traffic and a Private endpoint for the PHI flows. If Dedicated meets latency/cost targets, we will gradually decommission our K8s clusters.
- Security: we'll need your SOC 2 attestation and the completed security questionnaire. Our compliance team will review before pilot kickoff.

I've attached our completed security questionnaire responses (aurora-security-questionnaire-responses.pdf). We'll aim to have the network details and the peering contacts to Monica by EOD Monday.

If Monica can do the tech deep dive on Tuesday or Wednesday next week that would be great.

—Samir
Principal Product Manager | Aurora Health
samir@aurora-health.com

Perfect — thanks for the details, Samir. Monica, Rafael — looping you both in for scheduling and sizing.

Next steps (action items):
- Monica: can you propose two slots Tue/Wed for the 60-min deep dive? Please include any pre-reqs you want Aurora to fill (e.g., sample payloads, current model config, auth flow).
- Samir / Priya: please upload the IP ranges + peering contact and a representative sample of typical requests to the Drive link. That will let Monica run a quick sizing exercise before the call.
- Rafael: I attached a brief pilot SOW and the Q1 pricing sheet. The pilot we recommend: 4-week Dedicated pilot (reserved pool sized for peak concurrency) + private VPC endpoint for PHI workflows. Pilot acceptance criteria: 99th % latency < 250ms and no data egress from the private VPC for PHI flows.

If the pilot looks good, we can convert to a 12-month committed Dedicated contract with a migration plan for the remaining 70% of traffic.

Please confirm if Aurora can sign the SOW by Feb 26 so we can lock capacity for early March pilot start.

Attachments: RDW_SOW_dedicated_vs_private.pdf, pricing-sheet-q1-2027.xlsx

Thanks all — I’ll wait on Monica for proposed slots and will update the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567) after the deep dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
